report.name: rf_hw_timer_init
report.purpose: Initializes the RF (radio) hardware timer block used for radio-event scheduling (slot timing, calibration windows, RX/TX turnaround deadlines). Lives in the RF subsystem bring-up path: called once during chip/phy initialization so that lower MAC/PHY code can subsequently program one-shot/periodic timeouts via rf_hw_timer_set / rf_hw_timer_clear. It belongs to the RF control-plane initialization that runs before scan, TX and RX paths become active.

parameters.name: rf_ctx
parameters.purpose: opaque RF controller context (phy handle / base pointer) — passed in r0 by ARM-Thumb ABI, used to derive the RF MMIO base

return_value.meaning: 0 on success, non-zero if RF timer block failed to respond / ready bit never asserted

side_effects: writes RF timer control / prescaler / load-value MMIO registers (RF_TIMER_CTRL, RF_TIMER_PRESCALE, RF_TIMER_LOAD, RF_TIMER_INT_MASK)
clears pending RF timer interrupt status
enables the RF timer IRQ line in the RF interrupt controller
may pulse the RF timer clock-gate / soft-reset bit before configuration
report.summary: One-shot RF timer bring-up: clocks the timer block, programs prescaler/load, clears status, and registers its ISR before any RF scheduling API is used.
